questions_and_answers.question_text: Hànyǔ hěn fùzá, xuéqilai dàgài hěn nán?!

answers.answer_text: Chinese is very complicated. It must be very difficult to study?!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Fàngxīn ba! Wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ kěyi xuéde hěn hǎo.

answers.answer_text: Don't worry! I'm convinced you can learn it very well.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhōngdōngde Yīsīlánjiào hé Xīnjiāngde Yīsīlánjiào shì bu shì hěn bù yíyàng?

answers.answer_text: Is the Islam of the Middle East very different from the Islam of Xīnjiāng?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèi shi yíge xiāngdāng fùzáde wèntí, wǒmen kěyi tǎolùn tǎolùn.

answers.answer_text: This is a very difficult question. We can discuss it.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xīnjiāng hé nèidì shi shénme shíhou tǒngyīde?

answers.answer_text: When was Xīnjiāng united with the interior?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ǹg...dìyīcì tǒngyī chàbuduō shi gōngyuán qián liùshíniánde shíhou.

answers.answer_text: Uh...the first time they were unified was in about 60 B.C.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Jiěfàng Zhànzhēngde shíhou, Jiěfàngjūn jiěfàngle Xīnjiāng, shì bu shì?

answers.answer_text: During the War of Liberation, the PLA liberated Xīnjiāng, right?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xīnjiāng shi hépíng jiěfàngde, Jiěfàngjūn shi sìjiǔnián dào Xīnjiāng qùde.

answers.answer_text: Xīnjiāng was peacefully liberated. The PLA went to Xīnjiāng in 1949.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǔge zìzhìqūde shēnghuó qíngkuàng hé nèidì chà hěn duō ma?

answers.answer_text: Are living conditions in the five autonomous regions very different from those in the interior?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ǹg, zhǔyào shi jiāotōng bù fāngbian. Biéde shēnghuó fāngmiàn me, yě chà yìdiǎnr.

answers.answer_text: Well, it's mainly that transportation is difficult. As for other aspects of daily life, they're somewhat below standard too.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tāmen shi dào Shànghǎi qù chū chāi ma?

answers.answer_text: Did they go to Shànghǎi on business?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bù, bú shi fàng jià le ma? Yǒude gànbude jiā zài Shànghǎi, tāmen huí jiā qu kànkan.

answers.answer_text: No. We're on vacation now, remember? Some of the cadres' families are in Shànghǎi, so they went home to visit.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tz! Zhèitiáo dìtǎn zhēn měi! Shi Wéiwúěr dìtǎn ma?

answers.answer_text: Ah! This carpet is just beautiful! Is it a Uygur carpet?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì. Jiù shi zài nǐ zuótian cānguānde nèige gōngchǎng zuòde.

answers.answer_text: Yes. It was made in the factory you visited yesterday.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ kàn, tiān gāng liàng, Wéiwúěr nóngmín jiù kāishǐ gōngzuò le.

answers.answer_text: Look, it just got light and the Uygur peasants have already started to work.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Gèzú rénmín dōu zài dà gǎo shèhuìzhǔyì ma!

answers.answer_text: Sure, the people of all nationalities are going all out with socialism!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tīngshuō jǐwèi gōngren jiāo gěi zhèngfǔ jǐběn hěn lǎode shū, nǐmen kànguo le ma?

answers.answer_text: I hear that some workers handed a few very old books over to the government. Have you seen them?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Kànguo le. Dōu shi guānyú zhǒngzú wèntí, lìshǐ wèntíde, hěn yǒu yìsi.

answers.answer_text: Yes. They're about racial and historical problems. They're very interesting.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèige dìqūde xùmùyè nàme fādá!

answers.answer_text: This region's livestock farming is so well developed!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Suǒyǐ wǒmen zài zhèr bànle hǎojǐge dìtǎnchǎng.

answers.answer_text: That's why we've set up a lot of carpet factories here.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐmende wénzì nàme nán! Gǎo wénhuà jiāoliú duō bù róngyi.

answers.answer_text: Your system of writing is so hard! It makes cultural exchange so difficult!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shéi shuōde, wǒmende wénzì bú shi zài gǎi ma? Yuè gǎi yuè jiǎndān ma!

answers.answer_text: Says who! Aren't we changing our writing? The more we change it the simpler it is.
